recentItems.title: దేవరగట్టు కర్రల సమరానికి భారీ బందోబస్తు.. 1,000 మందితో పోలీసు నిఘా
recentItems.description:
Kurnool District Superintendent of Police Vikrant Patil has directed that the traditional 'stick battle' (Karra Samar) at the Devaragattu festival be conducted without any disturbances. To ensure smooth proceedings, a security deployment of over 1,000 police personnel has been arranged, along with surveillance through 300 CCTV cameras. Given the backdrop of local body elections, the SP urged participants to refrain from engaging in any intentional clashes or conflicts. Additionally, on the occasion of Police Martyrs' Day, a special ceremony was held at the parade grounds of the Kurnool SP office, where tributes were paid to police personnel who sacrificed their lives in the line of duty.

recentItems.description:
The United States has dismissed India's concerns over its growing relations with Pakistan and China. During a two-day visit to India, US Secretary of State Marco Rubio assured that America's relationships with any country in the world would never be at the expense of India's interests. Rubio specifically clarified that US diplomacy with Pakistan is not directed against India, but rather serves to reduce tensions in the region.
